Message:
I have always aspired
to be like Mother...
That has not changed,
even now...

But at some point,
I stopped trying to become
a songstress like Mother,
and tried to bring out
her sound instead...

I even thought I would be fine
if I never found out what
my own sound truly was...

Thinking like that...
I don’t have the right
to bear the name “Primavera”...!

Just then...
a mysterious melody
began to play around me...

This is my first time hearing it...
yet this melody
feels familiar somehow...
Do I know this sound...?

I cleared my mind,
and listened closely
to the song...

Ahh, this is the
sound of “Primavera”...!

Not just my mother’s...
It is all the songs sang
by every songstress
who has ever bore
the name “Primavera”...!
“Primavera.”

Their harmonizing songs
called for Primavera—
for me.

As though both in reproach,
and encouragement...

Suddenly, a familiar song
began to play
inside my heart...

This song...
It is from the day
I became Primavera...

The one I sang, desperate to
restore my mother’s heart...

...Ahh, yes...!
I have had my own sound
all along...!

“I must become
like Mother...”

So possessed was I
by that thought,
I simply tucked my own sound
away deep down inside my heart.

But, it was still there
just the same...
I will not let it go again.

My sound—
the symphonic color of
my heart as “Primavera”...!

Embracing my sound,
I took a deep breath...
